scientific_integrity: Authors of cited publications are credited only for their actual published results. The formula and classification here have not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: The complete spatial-period census concerns only states fixed by two temporal updates of elementary rule 18, not higher temporal periods. The spatial zeta is attached to this two-time fixed-point subshift, not to the full cellular automaton. Historical bibliographic priority remains a residual risk. The proof uses a finite transfer graph and algebraic identity; small-ring computations provide supplementary checks.
title: Exact temporal-two orbit census and spatial zeta for elementary cellular automaton 18
